response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, average_ratio, ABS(average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM type_averages)) AS distance_from_mean FROM type_averages;
